ValidationRule.description: An extra item (holding another file for its Primary Checklist Item) is accepted or returned only with that original item: the after-save trigger copies its status and sets Primary Item Status. Uploads are not affected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PrimaryChecklistItem__c)), ISCHANGED(Status), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Accepted"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Rejected")), TEXT(Status) <> PrimaryItemStatus__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This file belongs to another checklist item. Accept or return the original item and its extra files follow it.
